name: Chevy Chase Locos
description: Chevy Chase Locos was a Latino street gang based in the Chevy Chase area of Northeast Los Angeles. The gang is inactive, having been absorbed into the Toonerville Rifa 13 (TVR) gang. It is listed as one of Toonerville 13's cliques alongside the Vagos, Night Owls, Jokers, Tokers, and the Gangsters.
